beatbox.server.bad_definition: The service definition {definition} cannot be used: {problem}
beatbox.server.internal_udp_only: {definition} runs inside BeatBox, and BeatBox's own services speak UDP only for now.
beatbox.server.config_missing: {service} needs {key}, and it was not given.
beatbox.server.could_not_save: The server could not write down its services: {detail}
beatbox.server.no_such_service: This server has no service called {service}.
beatbox.server.bad_name: {name} cannot be a service's name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter.
beatbox.server.name_taken: This server already has a service called {name}.
beatbox.server.no_such_definition: There is no service definition called {definition}.
beatbox.server.needs_host: {service} runs inside a machine, and this server was made without one.
beatbox.server.needs_network: {service} needs a network, and this server has none.
beatbox.server.guest_not_linux: {service} cannot run there yet: services run in Linux machines only for now.
beatbox.server.configure_while_running: Stop {service} before changing how it is configured.
beatbox.server.did_not_start: {service} did not start: {said}. The Log tab has the rest.
beatbox.server.died: {service} stopped on its own. Its last log lines say why.
beatbox.server.program_missing: To start {service}, install {program} on the server's machine, then try again.
beatbox.server.prepare_failed: {service}'s requirements could not be checked. Check the machine and the settings.
beatbox.server.web_folder_missing: {folder} does not exist on {machine}. Copy the site there, or choose another folder.
beatbox.server.web_folder_absolute: Use the full folder path on the server's machine, such as /srv/www.
beatbox.server.web_command_missing: Enter the command that starts your web application, such as python3 app.py.
beatbox.server.web_command_invalid: The start command has unfinished quotes. Check it and try again.
beatbox.server.web_health_path_invalid: The check path starts with /, like /api/health.
beatbox.server.nginx_bad_upstream: "{upstream}" is not an address. Write host:port, like 127.0.0.1:3000.
beatbox.server.tls_failed: The HTTPS certificate could not be made: check openssl on the machine, or turn HTTPS off.
beatbox.server.web_https_application: A web application answers HTTPS itself. Turn HTTPS off here, or put an nginx service in front of the application and turn HTTPS on there.
beatbox.server.web_index_missing: {folder} has no index.html. Put the site there, or choose the folder that has it.
beatbox.server.web_not_readable: {user} cannot read {folder}. Let others read it (chmod -R o+rX), or choose another folder.
beatbox.server.bad_port: {service}'s configuration does not make a port.
beatbox.server.bad_period: A service may be given between 1 and {most} seconds to start.
beatbox.server.no_library: This server has no folder for your services.
beatbox.server.define_builtin: {definition} is the name of one BeatBox brings. Give yours another.
beatbox.server.define_exists: There is already a service type called {definition} in your folder.
beatbox.server.host_not_running: {service}'s machine is off. Turn it on first.
beatbox.server.host_unavailable: The server's machine is not available. Check it is running in Host.
beatbox.server.host_gone: This server's machine was deleted. Choose another in Configuration, or remove the services.
beatbox.srv.add.host_not_ready: “{name}” has to be running. Turn it on, then try again.
beatbox.srv.add.host_disk_missing: “{name}”'s disk is not there. Reconnect it first.
beatbox.server.network_not_running: {service}'s network is off. Turn it on first.
beatbox.server.node_failed: The server could not take its place on the network: {detail}
beatbox.server.dns_bad_name: {name} is not a name a record can have.
beatbox.srv.foot.stopped: Stopped. Open it to put it to work.
beatbox.srv.problem.slow: Running, but not answering. It may still be starting.
beatbox.srv.problem.failed: It stopped on its own. The log says why.
beatbox.srv.reach.dns: Machines on this network already find these names; this address is only for asking this server directly
beatbox.srv.reach.named: The other machines reach it at
beatbox.srv.edit.title: Edit {name}
beatbox.srv.edit.stop_first: Stop the service to edit its settings.
beatbox.srv.edit.name_fixed: The name identifies this service and cannot be changed here.
beatbox.srv.edit.secret_keep: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
beatbox.srv.sure_remove: Remove {name}? Its configuration goes with it.
beatbox.srv.reach.inbox: Web inbox (open from a machine on this network)
beatbox.srv.about.postgresql: Stores data for the network. Needs PostgreSQL installed in the machine. Finds its programs automatically and prepares the account; the password applies on first start.
beatbox.srv.about.smtp: Receives lab emails and shows them in a web inbox. Needs Mailpit 1.26.2 or newer in the machine. External delivery is not configured.
beatbox.srv.key.bin_directory.help: Leave empty to find PostgreSQL automatically.
beatbox.srv.key.database.help: Optional. Made on start if it does not exist yet, owned by the user below.
beatbox.srv.key.user.help: Optional. Made on start if it does not exist yet, with the password for the first start. Applications sign in with it.
beatbox.srv.key.accept_any_login.help: Turn on if an application insists on signing in before sending. Any name and password are accepted; sending without signing in keeps working.
beatbox.srv.start.postgresql.what: Store and query data with PostgreSQL.
beatbox.srv.start.smtp.what: Receive emails and read them in a web inbox.
beatbox.srv.about.http-static: Serves a simple page, a website folder or a web application on the network.
beatbox.srv.about.nginx: Serves a website folder using nginx. Requires nginx and Python 3 on the machine.
beatbox.srv.about.dns: Tells the machines which address each name has.
beatbox.srv.port.range: Enter a whole port number from 1 to 65535.
beatbox.srv.port.smtp_help: Applications send email to this port.
beatbox.srv.port.inbox_help: Open this port in a browser to read received messages.
beatbox.srv.nginx.mode.proxy: In front of a web application
beatbox.srv.key.upstream.help: Where the application answers, as seen from this machine: 127.0.0.1:3000 for one running here, or another machine and port such as 10.20.0.5:8080. nginx passes every visitor on to it.
beatbox.srv.key.https_port.help: With a certificate made on the machine itself. Browsers warn the first time, because nobody vouches for it. Needs openssl on the machine.
beatbox.srv.web.help: Choose a page, an existing folder or an application. Your files and dependencies must be on the server's machine.
beatbox.srv.web.folder_help: Full path inside the server's machine, not a folder on this computer. Folder and application modes preserve your files.
beatbox.srv.web.command_help: For example: python3 app.py or node server.js. Quotes group arguments; shell operators are not executed. PORT is set to the chosen port; you can also use {port} in the command. The application must listen on 0.0.0.0.
beatbox.srv.web.health_help: A page that returns success when the site is ready, such as / or /api/health.
beatbox.srv.empty.title: Nothing is working here yet
beatbox.srv.empty.about: A server gives the other machines on the network things to use. Start with one of these.
beatbox.srv.start.http-static.what: A page the machines open in a browser.
beatbox.srv.start.dns.what: Call a machine intranet.lab instead of {address}.
beatbox.srv.start.dns.what_plain: Call the machines by names, such as intranet.lab, instead of their addresses.
beatbox.srv.needs_network: Needs a server on a network
beatbox.srv.needs_machine: Needs a server with a machine
beatbox.srv.secret_kept: It is kept, and never written out again.
beatbox.srv.name: Name
beatbox.srv.name_hint: Only so you recognise it in the list.
beatbox.srv.new.title: New server
beatbox.srv.new.first: A server is somewhere to put to work what your network uses: a website, names for the machines, a service of your own.
beatbox.srv.new.none_machine: Only for services BeatBox runs on its own, like network names.
beatbox.srv.new.network_why: You need this to give the network names.
beatbox.srv.new.fixed: You can change this later, in Configuration, with the server off.
beatbox.srv.new.needs_network: Services need a machine or a network, and there is neither yet.
beatbox.srv.new.needs_pick: Pick a machine or a network above. A server needs one of them.
beatbox.screen.server.services.title: Services
beatbox.screen.server.services.blurb: What the server puts to work for the network: a website, names for the machines, a service of your own.
beatbox.screen.server.try.title: Try it
beatbox.screen.server.try.blurb: See whether the services work from another machine, and ask them what they can do.
beatbox.screen.server.library.title: Library
beatbox.screen.server.library.blurb: The kinds of service the server can put to work, and yours.
beatbox.screen.server.settings.title: Configuration
beatbox.screen.server.settings.blurb: The server itself: where it is and what it does when it starts.
beatbox.srv.try.lede: See whether your services work from another machine, and ask them what they can do.
beatbox.srv.library.lede: The kinds of service this server can put to work. Yours live in a folder and show up on every server.
beatbox.srv.settings.lede: The server itself: where it is and what it does when it starts.
beatbox.srv.try.cannot: This service cannot be tried from outside.
beatbox.srv.try.no_machine: No other machine is on. Turn one on in the same network, or add a light PC.
beatbox.srv.try.light_what: Opens the page or port like any machine would.
beatbox.srv.try.light_dns: Asks the network's DNS, like every machine.
beatbox.srv.try.light_login: Only checks the port opens. To sign in, use a virtual machine.
beatbox.srv.try.light_port: The database's port opened, in {ms} ms. Signing in was not tried.
beatbox.srv.try.http_error: {from} reached it, and it answered with an error
beatbox.srv.try.dns_said: It asked for {name} and the server said {answer}, in {ms} ms.
beatbox.srv.try.no_verdict: the network saw nothing go by
beatbox.srv.try.how: BeatBox asks the chosen machine to reach the service, as a user would, and shows what the network decided on the way.
beatbox.srv.action_failed: The request failed (code {code}). Details are shown below.
beatbox.srv.try.database_ok: {from} logged in and ran a query
beatbox.srv.try.auth_failed: The database refused these credentials. Check the user and password.
beatbox.srv.try.database_missing: The requested database does not exist.
beatbox.srv.try.connection_failed: Could not connect from this machine. Check the service, address and firewall.
beatbox.srv.try.tls_failed: The encrypted connection could not be checked. Check the certificate and TLS settings.
beatbox.srv.try.auth_unsupported: This authentication method is not supported by the test.
beatbox.srv.try.query_failed: The database session or test query did not complete successfully.
beatbox.server.pg_version_missing: This data needs PostgreSQL {version}. Install it, or choose its programs folder.
beatbox.server.nginx_bad_folder: The folder path must be one line, with no $.
beatbox.srv.try.nothing: Nothing to run here. Try it from another machine.
beatbox.srv.lib.name: What it is called
beatbox.srv.lib.program_hint: As you would type it on the machine. {porta} is replaced by the port below.
beatbox.srv.lib.health: How do I know it is well?
beatbox.srv.lib.health.tcp: It accepts connections on the port
beatbox.srv.lib.file: Advanced: the file that will be written
beatbox.srv.set.restore: Put back to work what was working
beatbox.srv.set.restore_what: If you turn the server off, the services stop. When you turn it back on, they start again on their own.
beatbox.srv.set.period: How long a service has to start
beatbox.srv.set.period_what: If it takes longer, it shows as "Not answering", but it is not turned off.
beatbox.srv.set.library_what: Files you put here show up in the Library of every server.
beatbox.srv.set.off_what: The services stop and come back when you turn it on.
beatbox.srv.set.on_what: The services that were working come back.
beatbox.srv.set.reset_what: Removes every service. The server stays, empty.
beatbox.srv.set.destroy_what: Everything goes: services, settings and logs. The machine and the network stay.
beatbox.srv.field.name: name
beatbox.srv.set.change_hint: You can change the machine and the network while the server is off. The services start again on the new machine when you turn it on.
beatbox.srv.set.running_lock: To change where the server is, turn it off first.
beatbox.srv.set.need_one: The server needs a machine or a network.
beatbox.srv.runs.trust: This type comes from your services folder, not from BeatBox. It runs the commands below as administrator (root) on the machine: use only ones you trust.
beatbox.srv.runs.title: What it runs on the machine
beatbox.srv.remove.data: What it left in the machine
beatbox.srv.remove.keep_what: A new one with the same name picks it up.
beatbox.srv.remove.delete_what: Gone for good. The machine has to be on.
beatbox.srv.remove.nothing: It leaves nothing in the machine.
beatbox.server.delete_data_needs_host: {service}'s data is in its machine. Turn the machine on to delete it, or keep the data.
beatbox.srv.new.apart: {machine} has no cable to {network}. Connect it in Host before adding services.
beatbox.srv.was_running: It stopped with its machine. Start it again.
beatbox.srv.helpers.title: What the server needs
beatbox.srv.helpers.none_network: No network: no names for the machines.
beatbox.srv.helpers.agent_no: Its agent does not answer: BeatBox cannot run services in it
beatbox.srv.helpers.cable_no: No cable to {network}: the machines there cannot reach it
beatbox.srv.helpers.missing: {program} is not installed, and {services} needs it
beatbox.srv.helpers.machine_off: Off: its services wait for it
beatbox.srv.helpers.names_ok: Its machines can find the server's names
beatbox.srv.helpers.network_off: Off: names and internal services wait for it
beatbox.srv.spark: The last {count} checks since this page opened
beatbox.srv.lately.title: Lately
beatbox.srv.reqs.title: Needs
beatbox.srv.helpers.names_none: On it, with no names to give yet
beatbox.srv.lib.machine_off: {machine} is off: turn it on to see what it has
beatbox.srv.lib.as_root: From your folder: runs this as root on the machine
beatbox.srv.lib.part.where: Where it answers, and how to tell it is well
beatbox.srv.lib.part.asks: What it asks whoever uses it
beatbox.srv.lib.not_on_machine: Not on {machine} yet. Install it there first.
beatbox.srv.lib.field.name: Name
beatbox.srv.lib.field.secret_hint: Asked when it is put to work, never shown
beatbox.srv.lib.field.how: Use one in the program by its name in braces, as with {porta}.
beatbox.srv.lib.preview: How it shows on the overview
beatbox.srv.foot.no_address: Working, with no address yet: is its network on?
beatbox.srv.was_running_network: It stopped with its network. It comes back when the network is on.
beatbox.srv.shared.title: What the services share
beatbox.srv.shared.names: Each service gets a name on the network
beatbox.srv.shared.names_none: When you add a service, it gets a name here.
beatbox.srv.shared.no_domain_what: The other machines reach the services by their address. With a domain, each one also gets a name, such as portal.srv.lab.
beatbox.srv.shared.certificate: One certificate for every HTTPS service
beatbox.srv.shared.certificate_what: For *.{domain}, made on the machine and self-signed. A browser that accepts it once accepts them all. Used from each service's next start.
beatbox.srv.shared.certificate_needs: Choose a domain first: the certificate is made for it.
beatbox.srv.shared.unused: not used by any service yet
beatbox.srv.shared.name: Name
beatbox.srv.shared.secrets_what: Set once, never shown, and never written in the events or the logs. A service that uses one gets the new value at its next start.
beatbox.srv.board.title: Services
beatbox.srv.foot.server_off: Waits for the server to be on.
beatbox.srv.side.server_off: The server is off. It starts again with the server.
beatbox.srv.helpers.names_waiting: Its names wait for the names service to run
beatbox.srv.after.title: Needs these services running first
beatbox.srv.after.none: None: it starts on its own
beatbox.srv.after.how: Starting it starts these first and waits for them to answer.
beatbox.srv.lately.restarting: {service} stopped on its own; trying to start it again (attempt {attempt})
beatbox.srv.set.order_what: From what each service needs: a service starts once the ones it needs answer. Change it in a service's panel.
beatbox.srv.set.order_none: No service needs another yet, so they start in the order of the list. Say what a service needs in its panel.
beatbox.srv.set.on_exit: If a service stops on its own
beatbox.srv.set.on_exit.retry: Start it again, up to 3 times
beatbox.srv.set.on_exit.leave.what: It stays stopped, with what it said last, until you put it back to work.
beatbox.srv.set.on_exit.retry.what: Looked at every 20 seconds. After three tries in a row it is left stopped; five steady minutes and the count starts again.
beatbox.srv.set.on_exit.always.what: Looked at every 20 seconds, and started again every time, also after its machine starts afresh.
beatbox.server.bad_on_exit: {value} is not something the server can do when a service stops: leave, retry or always.
beatbox.server.after_unknown: {service} cannot need {after}: this server has no service called that.
beatbox.server.after_loop: {service} cannot need that: it would need itself, through the services it needs.
beatbox.server.bad_domain: {domain} is not a domain. Use something like srv.lab.
beatbox.server.certificate_needs_domain: A shared certificate needs a domain to be made for.
beatbox.server.bad_secret_name: {name} cannot name a secret: lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
beatbox.server.no_such_secret: This server has no shared secret called {name}.
beatbox.server.secret_in_use: {name} is used by {by}: choose another value there first.
beatbox.server.after_failed: {service} needs {after}, and {after} did not start. Look at {after} first.
beatbox.server.after_silent: {service} needs {after}, and {after} is running but does not answer yet. Try again when it does.
beatbox.server.still_needed: {by} needs {service}: change what {by} needs first, then remove {service}.
